summary.intent: Execute all plans of GSD phase 68.1 (wiring CipherBox's web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain) via wave-based orchestration, then iterate through gap-closure rounds — driven by verification runs and live user bug reports — until the full web-e2e suite passes and outstanding gaps (including a GAP-6 product decision on the dead itemName backfill) are resolved.
summary.outcome: Executed 14 original plans plus 8 gap-closure plans (22 total, ~64+ commits); e2e failures dropped from a 6/208 baseline through 17→13→8 across gap rounds, with real bugs found and fixed (durable IPNS TEE enrollment, wrong-key decrypt in downloadFromIpns, shared-browser kind-cache wiring, cold-reload retry budget, folder-state adoption after publish). Verification round 2 still returned gaps_found (3/5 criteria); user decided GAP-6 should retire the dead plaintext itemName backfill and redesign it on the existing encrypted item_name_encrypted/ECIES pipeline, and a fresh full e2e run plus another gap round was in progress (uncovered and fixed a test-login secret mismatch, was mid-investigation of a conflict-detection regression) when the transcript ends.

repo: GSD decision-coverage gate parser requires the colon inside the bold group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not `- **D-04:** [informational]` — informational tags placed outside the bold fail silently with `could-not-parse`.

mock-ipns-routing (delegated routing mock, :3001) keeps records in an in-memory Map that is wiped on every container restart; restarting it casually during dev destroys any IPNS record lacking a DB-cached ipns_records row.
git stash is a shared ref across all worktrees in this repo's worktree-isolation setup — a subagent running `git stash push/pop` inside a worktree pollutes the main tree's stash list.
mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used busybox `wget localhost`, which resolves to ::1 while the app binds IPv4-only — always use 127.0.0.1 in healthchecks for this service.
API dev server listens on :3000; the delegated-routing mock is on :3001 — easy to confuse when health-probing.

The Playwright web-e2e test-login harness requires its secret to match between the API dev server's env and the e2e test env; a mismatch after restarting dev servers causes widespread, hard-to-diagnose spec failures that look like unrelated regressions.

Post-merge gates (typecheck + scoped sdk/sdk-core vitest) reliably catch stale test fixtures broken by upstream contract changes (e.g., fileKey→fileReadKey/fileWriteKey split) before they reach the exit gate.

code.finding: downloadFromIpns fed the parent folderKey into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata, which expects the file's own readKey — silent type coincidence (both Uint8Array) caused AEAD decrypt failures surfaced as 'Decryption failed' in the text editor/version history.
Cold-reload subfolder navigation retry budget was too low (MAX_RETRIES=3, RETRY_DELAY_MS=2000); raised to 8/3000 to fix GAP-2 cold-load timeout on nested folders.
resolveFileMetadata(fileMetaIpnsName, fileReadKey, ctx) explicitly expects the FILE's own readKey and calls unsealNode(publishedNode, fileReadKey) — callers must not pass a folder-level key.

Reconcile path refreshes folder state from network and throws ReconcileStaleError when network is ahead of local sequence; if a UI save path (e.g. text editor) isn't wrapped in the reconcile-retry loop, this can surface as a hung save/modal instead of the expected conflict UX.

workflow: Long-running background bash launched inside a subagent can silently lose its wake signal or have its transcript evicted; mitigate with an independent watchdog (poll a result-file mtime) plus prompt-based SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm, falling back to a fresh continuation agent with explicit completed-state context if evicted.

Live, hands-on user testing (headed-mode spec runs, manual logout/login, manual file preview) surfaced real bugs that the serial, abort-on-first-failure e2e suite structurally could never reach — 'suite green' does not mean every code path was exercised.
When a subagent dies mid-task (quota limit, eviction), validate its uncommitted diff against the plan/build/tests before committing on its behalf, rather than discarding the work.

friction: Exit-gate agent lost its background-task wake signal twice, requiring manual disk spot-checks and prompt-resume recovery each time.
Exit-gate agent was killed by an account session-limit mid-closeout, requiring the orchestrator to manually recover, fix, and commit its in-flight test-harness work.
test-login secret mismatch between the API dev server and e2e env caused a cluster of spurious failures that took extensive tracing (helper chain, secret sourcing, process inspection) to root-cause.
An orchestrator `tail`/pipe usage masked a real non-zero exit code from a test gate, briefly hiding a genuine regression.
git index.lock contention transiently blocked a tracking commit (resolved by verifying via git log and retrying).
Decision-coverage gate required two rounds of format fixes (bullet-colon normalization, then correct tag placement) before it parsed cleanly.
A worktree agent (68.1-21) misreported its own fork base in worktree_metadata, requiring manual git merge-base verification before recording.
A worktree agent (68.1-16) ran a prohibited `git stash push`, requiring cleanup of a stray shared stash entry without disturbing the user's own stashes.
open_items: GAP-6: retire the dead plaintext itemName backfill code and redesign the feature on the already-partially-shipped item_name_encrypted/ECIES pipeline — user decision made, implementation not yet started at transcript end.

Fresh full web-e2e suite confirmation run and next gap-closure plan/execution were in progress and not finished (conflict-detection 219 regression under active investigation as possible reconcile/retry-wrapping issue).

Undispositioned verification residuals: writable-shares 3.2 (Bob upload into shared folder, contradicts 68.1-20's intent, WEB-03 downgraded to Partial), sharing-workflow re-wrapping verification, rotation-durability SC-4.
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still returns an empty list — documented pre-existing gap needing its own follow-up plan.
